layout.name: Old Svalich Road (to Krezk) · 1 of 2

exits.down: On along Old Svalich Road (to Krezk)

rooms: The road out of Vallaki. A brook crosses the road at a ford: knee-deep, cold and quick over the stones.
Wolves on the road. Gnawed bones and a hollow under the roots. It smells of wet dog and old blood.
A rise above the road with one twisted tree on top. From up there you can see the next mile of road, and whatever is on it.
A dead oak full of ravens. They watch the road and say nothing.

events.label: Wolves on the road
events.text: Grey shapes keep pace in the trees on both sides. When the party stops, so do they.

events.label: Fork off Old Svalich Road (to Krezk)
events.text: A narrow track leaves the road. Stones have been set along both edges.

layout.riverNote: A brook crosses the road at a ford: knee-deep, cold and quick over the stones.

layout.name: The side road
rooms: Fork off Old Svalich Road (to Krezk)
A brook crosses the road at a ford: knee-deep, cold and quick over the stones.
A wayside shrine. A shrine to the Morninglord. Fresh candles, and a bench for the tired.
Three stones older than the road, on a low mound. Moss grows on every side but one.

events.label: A wayside shrine
events.text: A little shrine to the Morninglord with fresh candles. Somebody lit them within the hour. Nobody is here.

layout.riverNote: A brook crosses the road at a ford: knee-deep, cold and quick over the stones.
